rule.pass: PASS iff wrong(gate) <= 0.6 x wrong(control) AND solved(gate) >= solved(control) - 3 AND GPU Wh per solved case(gate) <= 1.5 x control (unrounded; energy covering all four nodes)
rule.wrong: an answered case whose answer fails the hidden holdout tests
rule.reported: solved, wrong, unanswered, agents started, generator tokens, sandbox seconds, wall, server generated tokens, Wh per solved, fallback cases, and SHARED-BUG cases separately (gate arm: every distinct passer agreed and the accepted answer is still wrong: the known blind spot)
rule.incomplete: INCOMPLETE (no decision) unless both arms are complete: each run embeds its plan, the plans differ only in arm fields, no runner errors, cases exactly the frozen 216 task x seed keys, runner exit 0, drain confirmed, no signal, energy covering all four nodes
